To keep cost reasonable we’ll request 20 common oxides, limiting to 3 polymorphs each and an energy‑above‑hull cutoff of 0.3 eV/atom. The data will be saved in a sub‑directory of the workdir.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>

  "compositions": [

    "MnO2","Cr2O3","SnO2","PbO","Na2O","K2O","BaO","SrO","ZrO2","HfO2"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_oxides_trial_13/polymorph_data"
}
